title: quanruirao/RecMorph
abstract:
Official implementation of RecMorph

# RecMorph: Topology-Guided Spatial Recurrence for Generalized Morphology Control Official implementation of **RecMorph: Topology-Guided Spatial Recurrence for Generalized Morphology Control**. RecMorph represents a robot as an ordered sequence of body or joint tokens and transports information along a topology-preserving traversal with a bidirectional recurrent policy. The repository contains two reproducible experimental tracks: - **UNIMAL:** morphology-general control on Flat Terrain, Incline, Exploration, Varied Terrain, and Obstacle tasks, including held-out morphology and zero-shot dynamics/kinematics evaluation. - **Isaac Lab:** one shared controller for Unitree Go1, Unitree Go2, ANYmal-B, and ANYmal-C, together with independently trained per-robot MLP policies and friction-sweep evaluation. The primary model is RecMorph-BiRNN. BiLSTM, BiGRU, and BiMamba2 variants use the same tokenization, topology ordering, actor/critic heads, and PPO pipeline. ## Repository Layout Generated populations, checkpoints, videos, and experiment logs are excluded from version control. ## UNIMAL Quick Start The UNIMAL stack was validated with Python 3.8, PyTorch 2.0.0, CUDA 11.8, Gym 0.17.1, `mujoco-py` 2.0.2.8, and MuJoCo 2.0. Train RecMorph-BiRNN on Flat Terrain with seed 1409: The first argument can be `ft`, `incline`, `exploration`, `vt`, or `obstacle`; the second can be `birnn`, `bilstm`, `bigru`, or `bimamba2`. See [docs/UNIMAL.md](docs/UNIMAL.md) for exact commands and data layout. ## Isaac Lab Quick Start The cross-platform experiments target Isaac Lab 0.41.3, Isaac Sim 4.5, Python 3.10, and RSL-RL 2.3.1. Install Isaac Lab by following its official installation guide, then expose the checkout path: Run a one-update reset/training smoke test: Train the formal shared policy: Train one independent MLP baseline: The shared environment advances all selected robots in the same simulator step and forms one PPO batch over all robot-environment pairs. Policy weights are shared. Rew
